desc:
Core Web Vitals and server rendering fixes make a JavaScript site load faster and read clearly to search engines. Ecom Swift LLC measures your real pages, moves key pages to server rendering, trims heavy scripts and cleans up titles, headings and structured data.

## What is server rendering, and why does it matter for search?

Server rendering means the server sends a page with its content already in the HTML, instead of sending an empty shell that the browser fills in with JavaScript. Visitors see content sooner, and search engines and other crawlers can read the page without running your scripts. For a React or other JavaScript site, this is often the biggest single change for both speed and search visibility.

## Why slow or unreadable pages cost you visitors

A page that takes too long to show anything loses people on the first screen, especially on phones and mobile connections. A page whose content only appears after scripts run may be read late or incompletely by crawlers. A site with missing titles, repeated descriptions or broken canonical addresses sends confusing signals about which page matters.

None of this is visible to the team that built the site, because it loads quickly on a developer laptop. It becomes visible when you test on a real mid-range phone or run a lab test on your public pages.

## How speed and clean markup affect traffic and sign ups

Core Web Vitals describe how fast the main content appears, how quickly the page responds to a tap and whether the layout jumps while loading. Better scores mean pages feel steady and quick. That helps visitors continue to the next step, and search engines use these signals as part of how they judge page experience, alongside content and links.

Clean markup helps in a different way. Clear titles, one main heading per page, sensible subheadings and structured data tell crawlers what each page is about. Social preview cards control how links look when shared. The effect builds over time and depends on your content and competitors, so we do not promise positions.

## What a great speed and SEO fix includes

- A Core Web Vitals test on your real pages, before and after the work.
- Key pages moved to server rendering or built ahead of time.
- Images resized, converted to modern formats and loaded only when needed.
- Fonts loaded efficiently, so text appears without a visible jump.
- Unused scripts, libraries and third party tags removed or deferred.
- Unique page titles and descriptions for the pages that matter.
- Canonical addresses, redirects, a sitemap and a robots file set correctly.
- Structured data on key pages, such as articles, products or organization details.
- Caching rules at the server edge for larger setups.
- A plain list of every change you can show your team.

## What we do

We run tests on your public pages and review the code that builds them. Then we fix the largest causes of slowness first and make the markup readable. The Basic package tests five pages and fixes images, fonts, titles and descriptions. Standard moves several key pages to server rendering, trims the code bundle and sets the sitemap, canonical rules and structured data. Premium extends this across more pages, adds edge caching, heading cleanup, social cards and a keyword plan for key pages.

We keep your design. The site should look the same and simply load and read better.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Give us the pages that matter most for traffic or sales.
- Share access to Search Console and analytics if you have them.
- Test on a real phone, not only on a fast computer.
- Keep one clear heading structure on every page.
- Re-measure a few weeks after launch.

**Avoid:**
- Adding another tracking script without checking its cost.
- Uploading full-size photos straight from a camera.
- Copying the same description to many pages.
- Blocking pages in the robots file by accident.
- Expecting overnight ranking changes.

## Who this is for

This service suits a business whose React site looks good but does not appear for its own services in search. It suits an owner whose pages score poorly on mobile speed tests. It also suits a team about to launch a Next.js site that wants correct rendering and markup from day one.

## What we need from you

Send the address of your site, access to the code repository as a collaborator and a list of your most important pages. Tell us which framework and hosting you use. We never need passwords. After you order, we send a checklist and keep you updated until the before and after results are ready.
